name: Ink Rag
shortDescription: A rag stained with honest Primer ink.
examineDescription: A square of linen stiff with dried Primer ink, mostly black with one thumbprint of it near the corner. Mentors keep a rag beside the book for wiping a nib, and they give the used one to the student whose page they have just signed. This one is yours because you cast when you were asked to.
